Skill scores for an AEME ensemble

Source: R/score_ensemble.R
score_ensemble.Rd

Verifies an ensemble against the lake observations. For every observation that falls on a date (and depth) the ensemble covers, the members' values at that point are compared with the observed value, and the comparisons are summarised per model, variable and depth, and over all depths.

The scores are

  • coverage - fraction of observations inside the central conf_int interval of the members. A reliable ensemble covers about conf_int; much less means it is over-confident. With few members the interval is estimated from empirical quantiles and under-covers even for a reliable ensemble: an n-member ensemble covers about (n - 1) * conf_int / (n + 1), roughly 80 % for a 95 % interval with 12 members, so judge coverage against that and not against conf_int alone;

  • bias - mean of (ensemble mean - observation);

  • rmse - root mean square error of the ensemble mean;

  • spread - root of the mean ensemble variance, i.e. the typical standard deviation among members;

  • spread_skill - spread / rmse. About 1 for a reliable ensemble, below 1 when the ensemble is under-dispersed (over-confident) and above 1 when it is over-dispersed;

  • crps - mean continuous ranked probability score, which rewards an ensemble that is both accurate and sharp. It has the units of the variable and lower is better; for a one-member ensemble it reduces to the absolute error.

Each observation is one case, so two observations at the same date and depth count twice. Cases where fewer than two members have a value are dropped.

Usage

score_ensemble(x, conf_int = 0.95, ...)

Arguments

x

an ensemble_summary() result, or an Aeme object carrying ensemble output. The summary must have been built with keep_members = TRUE and observations (add_obs = TRUE), and for a depth-resolved variable with depths, because members are only comparable with an observation at a common depth.

conf_int

numeric; central interval used for coverage. Default 0.95.

...

passed to ensemble_summary() when x is an Aeme object, for example model, vars_sim and depths. Ignored for a summary.

Value

A data.frame with one row per model, variable and depth (scope = "depth"), plus one pooled row per model and variable over all depths (scope = "overall", depth = NA). A variable without a depth dimension has only the pooled row. Columns are Model, var_sim, depth, scope, n_obs, coverage, bias, rmse, spread, spread_skill and crps. The central interval used is in attr(, "conf_int").

See also

ensemble_summary(), plot_ensemble(), run_aeme_ensemble()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
s <- ensemble_summary(aeme, model = "glm_aed", vars_sim = "HYD_temp",
                      depths = c(1, 5, 10))
score_ensemble(s)

# Or straight from an Aeme object with ensemble output
score_ensemble(aeme, model = "glm_aed", vars_sim = "HYD_temp",
               depths = c(1, 5, 10))
} # }
